project_type: Next.js 16 (App Router) with Supabase backend, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI components
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'pnpm type-check' to verify TypeScript types. 2. Run 'pnpm lint' to check code style. 3. Run 'pnpm build' to ensure production build succeeds. 4. Test manually in browser: start dev server with 'pnpm dev', visit affected pages, submit forms, verify realtime updates.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. All code is committed. .next/ build output is gitignored.
environment_constraints: - Must not break existing functionality. - All changes must maintain TypeScript type safety. - Must preserve business logic exactly. - Follow Next.js 14/15 App Router patterns. - Supabase client creation must use appropriate wrappers (server vs client vs API). - Rate limiting and CAPTCHA must remain functional. - Never restart the dev server (assumed running on localhost:3000).
contribution_requirements: - Follow existing code style and naming conventions. - Maintain backward compatibility. - Commit frequently with clear messages. - Test each change before proceeding. - Use descriptive variable and function names. - Add comments for complex logic.
key_patterns: - API routes use NextRequest/NextResponse. - Validation with Zod schemas. - Error handling with try-catch and logError utility. - Supabase clients: createClient() from @/lib/supabase/server (server), @/lib/supabase/client (client components), direct from @supabase/supabase-js (inconsistent in API routes - needs fixing). - Admin pages use 'use client' directive, Supabase realtime subscriptions, responsive table+mobile card layouts. - UI components from components/ui/ follow shadcn/ui patterns. - Constants centralized in lib/constants.ts. - API responses use apiSuccess/apiError helpers from lib/types/api.ts.
directory_structure: app/ (Next.js app directory with admin/, api/ subdirs), lib/ (utilities, Supabase clients, auth, types), components/ (UI components, admin components, shared components), hooks/ (custom React hooks), public/ (static assets), supabase/ (schema, migrations), scripts/ (maintenance scripts), docs/ (project documentation)
